title: Kylie Jenner Unfollows Both Tory Lanez and Megan The Stallion On IG
htmlContent:
The day after the alleged shooting incident on July 14, 2020, involving Megan The Stallion and Tory Lanez, Kylie Jenner secretly unfollowed both on Instagram. Megan The Stallion is not following Jenner either, but Lanez still is currently.

So, we know that Jenner is not picking sides, but we also know that Jenner knows exactly what happen between Lanez and Megan. Will she stay silent or expose the truth?

The day of the alleged shooting, Lanez, according a source that spoke with Heavy.com's Tanay Hudson. Lanez was seen by numerous witnesses flirting with Jenner by the pool and Stallion flipped out.

"All the witnesses at the pool party who have given statements say Meg got super jealous of Tory flirting with Kylie and flipped out. That being said, Kylie could be subpoenaed to show up in court to be a witness to what happened that night and Kylie’s people won’t let that happen and have a lot of influence with the Mayor of [Los Angeles]," said the source.

"Also the DA doesn’t want to bring it to court because they know they will lose the case based on the lack of evidence and contradictory statements. Also the neighbor/witness Megan talked about who called the police didn’t see anything, she just heard one gunshot and got a description of the car [and] that’s in the original police report. There is no video of the actual incident, that’s a lie."

Tory has mentioned in the single "Money Over Fallouts" on his album "DayStar," that Megan's team was pulling the strings to frame him as a villain.

"Girl, you had the nerve to write that statement on that affidavit, knowin' I ain't do it but I'm comin' at my truest," he revealed. "Tryna keep this shit two hunnid with you, shorty, I can't prove it / but them people in yo' ear, they the true ones that I fear / they really got you thinkin' Tory Lanez would do you in, for real / don't forget you was my bitch, I held it down and kept it real." 

On Friday afternoon an associate of Stallion that goes by Itgirlnation_ on Instagram wrote a post in reference to Megan's behavior under the influence of alcohol.

"I wanna say this and I won't say anything [else] about this, I've provided clothes for Megan when I first opened my boutique and it's been plenty of times when Tory [Lanez] been around. Megan gets drunk and becomes very disrespectful and physically abusive. I'm not saying that Megan is lying about what happen because I wasn't there I was only in the condo the previous day," she wrote.

"When I dropped clothes off to her and she was indeed drunk and again very aggressive to Tory. I feel there is three sides to every story because something is not right. And before y'all start that protect black woman. I am a black woman. Megan is heaven sent, and most def[inately] amazing person, but she is still grieving grandmother and mother, and she abuses alcohol and it turns her into a different person. But, you guys will see when Kelsey speaks and she will be speaking soon. I saw her yesterday as I dropped clothes off to her, but she has a story to tell. And I just want to say it ain't too far off from what Tory is saying."

According to Hudson, her source shared that an argument ensued in the car after Megan and Kelsey found out they were sleeping with Lanez.

“It wasn’t Tory and Megan arguing in the car, it was Megan and Kelsey arguing because they found out that night that they were both sleeping with Tory when Megan got jealous over Kylie. That’s why they are no longer friends and had the big falling out. They almost came to blows in the car because everyone was drunk. It was a big mess.”
